excerpt.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
excerpt.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

texts.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
texts.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]用[system.GetName]星系最近发生的战斗实例的特征向量开发了一组新的战术数据。
texts.en: [officer.GetName] has developed a new tactical data set from the feature vectors of the recent combat instance in the [system.GetName] system.

texts.zh: 指挥官[officer.GetName]自从[officer.GetHerHis]在[system.GetName]星系吃了败仗之后就一蹶不振。[officer.GetHerHis]麾下的将领汇报这位指挥官已经不无法像之前那样胜任[officer.GetHerHis]的职责了。
texts.en: Commander [officer.GetName] appears to have grown distant and depressed since [officer.GetHerHis] defeat in the recent battle that took place in the [system.GetName] system. The officers under [officer.GetHerHis] command report that the Commander no longer performs [officer.GetHerHis] duties with the same gusto as before.
